dom_aria_only.name: DOM / ARIA Only
dom_aria_only.primary_failure: Fails on Canvas / SVG / visually occluded elements lacking ARIA accessibility trees

screenshot_only.name: Screenshot Only (Pure VLM)
screenshot_only.privacy_exposure: HIGH without local redaction boundary (raw viewport sent to model)
screenshot_only.primary_failure: Slow latency (7.2s/step), resolution limits on dense forms, hallucinates click coordinates
flaws_detected: Bounding box jitter on subpixel links

dom_plus_screenshot_eager.name: Eager DOM + Full Screenshot (Standard Web Agent)
dom_plus_screenshot_eager.privacy_exposure: MODERATE/HIGH if full image and unredacted DOM dispatched to cloud/local VLM
dom_plus_screenshot_eager.primary_failure: High latency (7.3s/step); redundant VLM calls on trivial next/submit buttons
flaws_detected: Redundant heavy compute on simple interactive steps

privateeye_dual_tier.name: PrivateEye Tier-1 Fast Local + Selective Fallback
privateeye_dual_tier.privacy_exposure: ZERO (Canaries masked locally before any visual crop or text leaves boundary)
privateeye_dual_tier.primary_failure: Fallback required only on ambiguous visual targets (17.7% rate)
flaws_detected: Single failure on deeply nested shadow DOM without ARIA labels requiring interactive recovery

conclusion: Dual-tier perception achieves 95% accuracy while reducing mean turn latency from 7.3s down to 1.28s (and p50 to 14.5ms) with zero privacy leakage.
